articles.title_en: Land Concentration and Long-Run Development in the Frontier United States
articles.title_cn: 美国边疆地区的土地集中与长期发展
articles.abstract_en: I study the long-run economic effects of land concentration on the American frontier. Using quasi-random variation in initial land allocations from a checkerboard formula, I analyze a large database of property assessments and find that historical concentration reduced modern land values by 4.5 percent and fixed capital by 23 percent. Modern effect sizes are 23–64 percent of their historical equivalents, indicating significant rates of both persistence and convergence over the last 150 years. Using archival data on tenant contracts, I argue that the low-powered incentives of share agreements discouraged investment by large-scale owners with long-term effects. (JEL D82, G31, N41, N51, Q12, Q15, Q24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了美国边疆地区土地集中对长期经济效应的影响。利用棋盘格公式初始土地分配的准随机变异，我分析了一个大型财产评估数据库，发现历史上的集中使现代土地价值降低了4.5%，固定资本降低了23%。现代效应规模为其历史对应物的23-64%，表明在过去150年中存在显著的持续性和收敛性。利用租户合同的档案数据，我认为分成协议的低能激励抑制了大规模所有者的投资，并产生了长期影响。(JEL D82, G31, N41, N51, Q12, Q15, Q24)

articles.title_en: The Effects of Racial Segregation on Intergenerational Mobility: Evidence from Historical Railroad Placement
articles.title_cn: 种族隔离对代际流动的影响：来自历史铁路布局的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new evidence on the causal impacts of citywide racial segregation on intergenerational mobility. We use an instrumental variable approach that relies on plausibly exogenous variation in segregation due to the arrangement of railroad tracks in the nineteenth century. Our analysis finds that higher segregation reduces upward mobility for Black children from households across the income distribution and White children from low-income households. Moreover, segregation lowers academic achievement while increasing incarceration and teenage birth rates. An analysis of mechanisms shows that segregation reduces government spending, weakens support for antipoverty policies, and increases racially conservative attitudes among White residents. (JEL I38, J13, J15, J62, N32, N72, R30)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于全市种族隔离对代际流动因果影响的新证据。我们采用工具变量方法，依赖于十九世纪铁路轨道布局导致的隔离的外生变异。我们的分析发现，更高的隔离降低了收入分布各阶层黑人儿童和低收入白人儿童的向上流动性。此外，隔离降低了学业成绩，同时增加了监禁率和青少年生育率。机制分析表明，隔离减少了政府支出，削弱了对反贫困政策的支持，并增加了白人居民中种族保守态度。(JEL I38, J13, J15, J62, N32, N72, R30)

articles.title_en: The Impact of Dating Apps on Young Adults: Evidence from Tinder
articles.title_cn: 约会应用对年轻人的影响：来自Tinder的证据
articles.abstract_en: Online dating apps have transformed the dating market, yet their broader effects remain unclear. We study Tinder's impact on college students using its initial marketing focus on Greek organizations for identification. We show that the full-scale launch of Tinder led to a sharp, persistent increase in sexual activity, but with little corresponding impact on the formation of long-term relationships or relationship quality. Dating outcome inequality, especially among men, rose, alongside rates of sexual assault and STDs. However, despite these changes, Tinder's introduction did not worsen students' mental health on average and may have even led to improvements for female students. (JEL I12, I23, J13, J16, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 在线约会应用已经改变了约会市场，但其更广泛的影响仍不明确。我们利用Tinder最初针对希腊组织的营销重点作为识别策略，研究其对大学生的影响。我们表明，Tinder的全面推出导致了性活动的急剧且持续增加，但对长期关系的形成或关系质量几乎没有相应影响。约会结果的不平等，尤其是在男性中，有所上升，同时性侵犯和性传播疾病的发生率也上升。然而，尽管有这些变化，Tinder的引入并未平均恶化学生的心理健康，甚至可能对女学生有所改善。(JEL I12, I23, J13, J16, L86)

articles.abstract_en: Two mechanisms have been proposed to explain sex selection in India: son preference, in which parents desire a male heir, and daughter aversion, in which dowry payments make parents worse off with girls. Our model incorporates both mechanisms, providing microfoundations, based on the organization of the marriage institution, for daughter aversion. Marital matching, sex selection, and dowries are jointly determined in the model, whose implications are tested on a representative sample of rural households. Simulations of the model indicate that existing policies targeting daughter aversion might exacerbate the problem, while identifying other policies that could be effective. (JEL D31, G51, J12, J16, O12, O18, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 已有两种机制被提出来解释印度的性别选择：儿子偏好，即父母希望有男性继承人；以及女儿厌恶，即嫁妆支付使父母因女孩而境况变差。我们的模型融合了这两种机制，基于婚姻制度的组织，为女儿厌恶提供了微观基础。婚姻匹配、性别选择和嫁妆在模型中是联合决定的，其含义在具有代表性的农村家庭样本上进行了检验。模型模拟表明，现有的针对女儿厌恶的政策可能会加剧问题，同时识别出其他可能有效的政策。(JEL D31, G51, J12, J16, O12, O18, Z13)

articles.title_en: How Equality Created Poverty in Preindustrial Japan, 1600–1870
articles.title_cn: 平等如何在前工业化日本制造了贫困，1600-1870年
articles.abstract_en: Despite well-developed economic institutions, premodern Japan, 1600–1868, had among the lowest real wages according to available estimates, around half those in preindustrial England. However, many Japanese peasants owned land, unlike their mostly landless English counterparts, due to institutional differences in land inheritance. Using a Malthusian model, I show that this greater landownership equality paradoxically led to Japan's lower wages and GDP per capita. Evidence from Japanese village censuses supports the mechanism. If, as many historians believe, high wages in Western Europe spurred industrialization, Japan's failure to industrialize first could have been shaped by its unusual preindustrial equality. (JEL D63, E23, J31, N15, N35, N45, N55)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管拥有发达的经济制度，根据现有估计，前现代日本（1600-1868年）的实际工资是最低的之一，约为前工业化英格兰的一半。然而，与大多数无地的英国农民不同，由于土地继承制度的差异，许多日本农民拥有土地。通过使用马尔萨斯模型，我表明这种更大的土地所有权平等反而导致了日本较低的工资和人均GDP。来自日本村庄普查的证据支持了这一机制。如果正如许多历史学家所认为的那样，西欧的高工资刺激了工业化，那么日本未能率先实现工业化可能是由其不寻常的前工业化平等所塑造的。（JEL D63, E23, J31, N15, N35, N45, N55）

articles.title_en: The Long-Term Impacts of Mixing the Rich and Poor: Evidence from Conscript Dorms
articles.title_cn: 贫富混合的长期影响：来自征兵宿舍的证据
articles.abstract_en: To what extent is economic success determined by with whom individuals interact socially? We tackle this question by exploiting a large-scale natural experiment in the Finnish conscription. Our research design is based on the alphabetization of dorms, which is shown to induce as good as random variation in peer composition. Dormmates from high-income families have a positive impact on earnings, with the largest effect among individuals from high-income families. For them, a one standard deviation increase in dormmates' parental income increases long-term earnings by 5.7 percent. The results support labor market networks among the rich as the key mechanism. (JEL D12, D31, G51, I32, J31, J45)
articles.abstract_cn: 经济成功在多大程度上取决于个体与谁进行社交互动？我们通过利用芬兰征兵制度中的大规模自然实验来探讨这一问题。我们的研究设计基于宿舍的字母排序，这被证明能引起近乎随机的同伴构成变化。来自高收入家庭的室友对收入有积极影响，其中对高收入家庭个体的影响最大。对于他们而言，室友父母收入每增加一个标准差，长期收入增加5.7%。结果支持富裕人群中的劳动力市场网络是关键机制。(JEL D12, D31, G51, I32, J31, J45)

articles.title_en: Real-World Effectiveness of the Influenza Vaccine in Young Children
articles.title_cn: 流感疫苗在幼儿中的实际有效性
articles.abstract_en: Influenza causes substantial illness among children. RCTs demonstrate that the influenza vaccine reduces active-surveillance-detected influenza but have insufficient samples to examine outcomes such as health care provider visits. This study documents that children whose well-child visits occur when the seasonal influenza vaccine is broadly available are 23.4 pp more likely to be vaccinated than children whose visits do not. Using large administrative health care datasets, we leverage this vaccination-rate variation to show that the vaccine reduces outpatient and ED visits significantly. The results imply that making pediatric influenza vaccinations more convenient could substantially increase vaccination rates and reduce health care expenditures. (JEL I11, I12, I18, J13)
articles.abstract_cn: 流感在儿童中导致大量疾病。随机对照试验表明，流感疫苗可减少主动监测发现的流感，但样本量不足以检验如医疗服务提供者就诊等结果。本研究记录到，在季节性流感疫苗广泛可及期间进行健康儿童访视的儿童，其接种疫苗的可能性比未在此期间访视的儿童高出23.4个百分点。利用大型行政医疗数据集，我们利用这种疫苗接种率的差异来显示，疫苗显著减少了门诊和急诊就诊。结果表明，提高儿科流感疫苗接种的便利性可大幅提高接种率并减少医疗支出。（JEL I11, I12, I18, J13）

articles.title_en: Ethnic Diversity, Historical Economic Exchange, and Development: Evidence from Andean Peru
articles.title_cn: 民族多样性、历史经济交流与发展：来自安第斯秘鲁的证据
articles.abstract_en: Is ethnic diversity good or bad for economic development? Most studies find corrosive effects. This paper shows that historical exposure to economic exchange can mitigate these effects in the long run. I collect data from a natural experiment of Peru's colonial history: the forced resettlement of native populations in the sixteenth century. Where the resettlement concentrated ethnically diverse populations with a history of internal crop exchange, contemporary populations perform better systematically. Additional evidence suggests that prior experience with mutually beneficial crop exchange shaped more open attitudes toward out-group members. Economic complementarities helped sustain long-run, market-oriented cooperation and local trade. (JEL F54, J15, N16, N36, N56, O15, Q12)
articles.abstract_cn: 民族多样性对经济发展是好是坏？大多数研究发现其具有腐蚀性影响。本文表明，历史上接触经济交流可以在长期内缓解这些影响。我利用秘鲁殖民历史的自然实验收集数据：十六世纪土著人口的强制重新安置。在重新安置集中了具有内部作物交换历史的多元民族人口的地方，当代人口表现系统性更好。额外证据表明，先前互利作物交换的经验塑造了对外群体成员更开放的态度。经济互补性有助于维持长期的、市场导向的合作和本地贸易。(JEL F54, J15, N16, N36, N56, O15, Q12)

articles.title_en: Cassatts in the Attic: Is There a Gender Gap in the Commercialization of Science
articles.title_cn: 阁楼上的卡萨特：科学商业化中是否存在性别差距
articles.abstract_en: We analyze nearly 70 million scientific articles to estimate the gender dynamics in the commercialization of science. We report a gender gap of 14 percent, which does not appear to be explained either by the quality of the science or by its commercial potential. The gap is widest among papers with female last authors (i.e., lab head or principal investigator), even when publishing high-quality science. However, the gap vanishes when authors self-commercialize discoveries via new ventures, and the gap is reduced when commercializing in cooperation with firms that are smaller or that have more female inventors. (JEL D22, I23, J16, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了近70万篇科学文章，以估计科学商业化中的性别动态。我们报告了14%的性别差距，这一差距似乎既不能由科学质量解释，也不能由其商业潜力解释。在女性最后作者（即实验室负责人或首席研究员）的论文中，差距最为显著，即使发表的是高质量科学。然而，当作者通过新创企业自行商业化发现时，差距消失，而与规模较小或拥有更多女性发明者的公司合作商业化时，差距缩小。（JEL D22, I23, J16, O31, O34）

articles.title_en: Release, Detain, or Surveil? The Effect of Electronic Monitoring on Defendant Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 释放、羁押还是监控？电子监控对被告结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of pretrial electronic monitoring (EM) relative to both pretrial release and pretrial detention (jail). EM often involves a defendant wearing an electronic bracelet, which aims to reduce pretrial misconduct at a low cost. Using the quasi-random assignment of bond court judges, I estimate the effect of EM versus release and EM versus detention on pretrial misconduct, case outcomes, future recidivism, and aggregate total costs. Results indicate that EM reduces overall costs relative to detention. However, EM does not prevent enough high-cost crime to justify its use relative to release. (JEL K14, K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了审前电子监控（EM）相对于审前释放和审前羁押（监禁）的效果。电子监控通常涉及被告佩戴电子手环，旨在以低成本减少审前不当行为。利用保释法庭法官的准随机分配，我估计了电子监控相对于释放和电子监控相对于羁押对审前不当行为、案件结果、未来再犯以及总成本的影响。结果表明，电子监控相对于羁押降低了总成本。然而，电子监控并未能预防足够多的高成本犯罪，以证明其相对于释放的合理性。（JEL K14, K41, K42）

articles.title_en: Age at School Entry and Human Capital Development: Evidence from Lesotho
articles.title_cn: 入学年龄与人力资本发展：来自莱索托的证据
articles.abstract_en: Evidence on school-entry age impacts in lower-income countries is limited. We assess how school starting age affects human capital development in Lesotho, exploiting an enrollment age threshold. Children who start primary school at older ages overcome initial skill deficits as they progress. They are more likely to remain in school, spend less time on economic and household activities, and obtain substantially higher total years of schooling. In adulthood they are more likely to have professional occupations and less likely to be married or have children as teenagers, become HIV infected (men), and experience the death of a child (women). (JEL I12, I21, I25, I26, J13, J24, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 关于低收入国家入学年龄影响的证据有限。我们利用入学年龄门槛，评估了莱索托入学起始年龄对人力资本发展的影响。较晚开始小学教育的儿童在进步过程中克服了初始技能缺陷。他们更有可能继续在校学习，花在经济和家务活动上的时间更少，并获得显著更高的总受教育年限。成年后，他们更可能从事专业职业，更不可能在青少年时期结婚或生育，感染HIV（男性），以及经历子女死亡（女性）。（JEL I12, I21, I25, I26, J13, J24, O15）

articles.title_en: Information Frictions and Employee Sorting between Start-ups
articles.title_cn: 信息摩擦与初创企业间的员工排序
articles.abstract_en: Would workers apply to better firms if they were more informed about firm quality? Collaborating with 26 science-based start-ups, we create a custom job board and invite business school alumni to apply. The job board randomizes across applicants to show coarse expert ratings of all start-ups' science and/or business model quality. Making ratings visible strongly reallocates applications toward higher-rated firms. This reallocation holds, restricting to high-quality workers. Treatments operate in part by shifting worker beliefs about firms' right-tail outcomes. Despite these benefits, workers make posttreatment bets indicating highly overoptimistic beliefs about start-up success, suggesting a problem of broader informational deficits. (JEL D22, D83, J22, J23, J24, M13, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 如果工人更了解企业质量，他们会申请更好的企业吗？我们与26家科学型初创企业合作，创建了一个定制招聘板，并邀请商学院校友申请。招聘板随机向申请者展示所有初创企业科学和/或商业模式质量的粗略专家评级。使评级可见显著地将申请重新分配至评级更高的企业。这种重新分配在仅考虑高质量工人时依然成立。处理效应部分通过改变工人对企业右尾结果的信念发挥作用。尽管有这些好处，工人在处理后下注时表现出对初创企业成功的高度过度乐观信念，这表明存在更广泛的信息缺失问题。(JEL D22, D83, J22, J23, J24, M13, M51)
